scheme_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-I
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow and the mother of a girl child
Benefit is granted for the marriage of only one daughter
Application must be submitted at least 40 days before the marriage date (one day allowed in exceptional circumstances)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 plus a 1 Sovereign (8 gm) 22‑carat gold coin for the daughter’s marriage.
